name: Teleport
description: As part of its move, the creature can magically teleport a short distance to an unoccupied space it can see, rather than moving normally.

mechanics.text: As part of its move, the creature can magically teleport a short distance to an unoccupied space it can see, rather than moving normally.
The creature magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
The creature teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
As a bonus action, the creature can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
